identity: Neutral gas-phase covalent dinitrogen pentoxide O2N-O-NO2, CAS 10102-03-1, singlet molecule; not solid nitronium nitrate, aqueous nitric acid or an aggregate of independent NO2+ and NO3- ions.
recommendation: A bounded NASA-thermal/ATcT candidate is available for later evaluation; retain curated now. Do not invent a JANAF0 K anchor or infer physical D0 from the inherited fit intercept, since the official JANAF table omits 0 K caloric entries.
science: The native current/NASA ratio falls from its low-temperature value to 0.812 at 4000 K; NASA/ATcT gives 1.174 relative to current there. The official JANAF0 K row is blank, so the source alignment here deliberately removes balanced reaction enthalpy at 298.15 K and leaves JANAF D0 unavailable. NASA header and ATcT0 K energies remain independently usable. This makes the follow-up finite and actionable without a fabricated energy-only correction.
modern: The latest ATcT species/provenance page was inspected and the covalent gas identity was checked separately from its condensed entry. It is strongly linked to the NO3 dissociation threshold and the measured NO2+NO3/N2O5 equilibrium. Osthoff et al.2007 is a concrete primary equilibrium source at atmospheric temperatures; the publisher abstract was inspected, not the full paper. That cold equilibrium evidence is not extrapolated as a validated 4000 K thermal function.
importance: N2O5 is a reservoir in nighttime oxidizing nitrogen chemistry and can participate in heterogeneous conversion. The present hot reducing ideal-gas inventory does not include those kinetic or aerosol processes.
conventions: The covalent molecular gas is not represented as a charged ion pair. Internal torsion and symmetry belong to the molecular evaluated function; no separate conformer/spin multiplier is appended. The 298 K alignment is labelled throughout and is not called a zero-temperature atomization alignment. Native NASA R and fixed H298/H0 gauges are preserved.
followup: Construct a NASA-thermal/ATcT candidate with explicit energy zero and compare G/H/S/Cp and current-network substitutions. A retained-thermal energy-only model would first need an independently justified original 0 K energy reference; do not manufacture it by extrapolating JANAF or the fitted 1/T term. DOI10.1039/B709193A is optional useful cold-equilibrium validation, not a mandatory hold on this scoped review.
